Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
12:02 AM

The National Museum is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays.

Entry for Indian adults is ₹20. Students up to class 12 get in free with their ID card. Foreign nationals pay ₹500.

This is from the museum's official Plan Your Visit page. Tickets can be booked online at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. Tomorrow, Thu 29 Oct, it is open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
